title: Putnam FL Investment Management Co. Sells 11,434 Shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:
Putnam FL Investment Management Co. lessened its holdings in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 4.6% during the 1st quarter, according to its most recent disclosure with the SEC. The institutional investor owned 235,705 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 11,434 shares during the quarter. Apple comprises about 3.6% of Putnam FL Investment Management Co.’s holdings, making the stock its biggest holding. Putnam FL Investment Management Co.’s holdings in Apple were worth $39,547,000 at the end of the most recent quarter.
Several other institutional investors and hedge funds have also modified their holdings of AAPL. Schwab Charles Investment Management Inc. increased its stake in shares of Apple by 3.1% during the fourth quarter. Schwab Charles Investment Management Inc. now owns 19,262,302 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $3,259,868,000 after buying an additional 570,279 shares during the period. Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Holdings Inc. increased its stake in shares of Apple by 2.2% during the fourth quarter. Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Holdings Inc. now owns 15,841,037 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,680,779,000 after buying an additional 346,446 shares during the period. Parametric Portfolio Associates LLC increased its stake in shares of Apple by 4.1% during the third quarter. Parametric Portfolio Associates LLC now owns 12,109,070 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $1,866,250,000 after buying an additional 479,466 shares during the period. Fisher Asset Management LLC increased its stake in Apple by 2.9% in the fourth quarter. Fisher Asset Management LLC now owns 11,206,974 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,896,556,000 after purchasing an additional 318,571 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Sanders Capital LLC increased its stake in Apple by 1.6% in the fourth quarter. Sanders Capital LLC now owns 8,623,285 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,574,905,000 after purchasing an additional 139,700 shares during the last quarter. 58.07% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors and hedge funds. Several brokerages have commented on AAPL. Barclays increased their price target on shares of Apple from $161.00 to $175.00 and gave the company an “equal weight” rating in a research note on Tuesday. Sanford C. Bernstein reiterated a “neutral” rating and issued a $190.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Monday. BidaskClub upgraded shares of Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating in a research note on Monday, June 18th. UBS Group set a $210.00 price target on shares of Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research note on Wednesday, June 13th. Finally, Macquarie reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $197.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Monday, June 11th. One investment analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, sixteen have given a hold rating, thirty-one have assigned a buy rating and two have issued a strong buy rating to the stock. Apple has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $207.20.
In related news, insider Philip W. Schiller sold 69,491 shares of Apple stock in a transaction dated Tuesday, April 3rd. The stock was sold at an average price of $166.42, for a total transaction of $11,564,692.22. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available at this link . Also, insider Luca Maestri sold 39,122 shares of Apple stock in a transaction dated Friday, April 13th. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.66, for a total value of $6,833,048.52. Following the sale, the insider now owns 64,475 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $11,261,203.50. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . In the last 90 days, insiders sold 279,074 shares of company stock valued at $49,607,454. Company insiders own 0.08% of the company’s stock.
Shares of Apple opened at $185.50 on Friday, Marketbeat reports. Apple Inc. has a fifty-two week low of $142.28 and a fifty-two week high of $194.20. The firm has a market capitalization of $934.43 billion, a PE ratio of 20.14, a PEG ratio of 1.52 and a beta of 1.29. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.80, a current ratio of 1.46 and a quick ratio of 1.37.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings results on Tuesday, May 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.73 earnings per share for the quarter, beating analysts’ consensus estimates of $2.69 by $0.04. Apple had a return on equity of 39.97% and a net margin of 21.55%. The business had revenue of $61.14 billion during the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $60.94 billion. During the same quarter last year, the business posted $2.10 earnings per share. The business’s revenue for the quarter was up 15.6% on a year-over-year basis. sell-side analysts anticipate that Apple Inc. will post 11.42 earnings per share for the current fiscal year.
Apple announced that its board has approved a share repurchase program on Tuesday, May 1st that authorizes the company to buyback $100.00 billion in shares. This buyback authorization authorizes the iPhone maker to buy up to 11.9% of its stock through open market purchases. Stock buyback programs are generally an indication that the company’s management believes its stock is undervalued.
